# Russell Labey

Russell Labey is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Russell Labey has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/russell-labey#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 56.4% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230401145653/https://archive.vote.je/portfolio/labey-russell/)
  - [2014 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/election-special-2014-what-they-said/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iZT-zILbM0o)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/russell-labey#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 49.5% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/russell-labey-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wSnmKydHwmA)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ISt1B06MlVk)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/russell-labey#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/russell-labey/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ioNLsU2o0Hg)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=26)

## Election History

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-1) (3 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Russell Labey was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin)** |  | 946 | 65.8% |
| 2 | **Russell Labey** |  | 811 | 56.4% |
| 3 | **[Scott Wickenden](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/scott-wickenden)** |  | 476 | 33.1% |
| 4 | [Shannen Kerrigan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/shannen-kerrigan) | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 355 | 24.7% |
| 5 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 311 | 21.6% |
| 6 | [Gino Risoli](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gino-risoli) |  | 192 | 13.4% |

1,437 ballots (inc. 26 spoilt papers)

5,333 registered voters

= 26.9% turnout
